title: Abortion: Right or Wrong?
author: Dorothy Thurtle
current_text: Abortion: Right or Wrong? was banned in Ireland in 1942.

sources.quote: Abortion: Right or Wrong? | All | Dorothy Thurtle | T. Werner Laurie Limited, London | 13th February, 1942 |

Three of the books are explicitly about abortion: Abortion Internationally (banned since 1983), Abortion: Our Struggle for Control (also banned in 1983) and Abortion: Right or Wrong (banned seventy years ago in 1942).
sources.title: Censored: The 274 books and magazines still banned in Ireland today

ban_rows.note: Register of Prohibited Publications, Part II. Explicitly cited by name in a 2025 parliamentary answer as still listed; legal basis abolished 2018.
